title: Checkout ledger rollout
summary: Checkout now appends every accepted order to a ledger service and table; the synchronous audit hop and its audit_log table are retired.

views.title: Orders schema
views.caption: ledger_entries joins orders through order_id; audit_log stays as a ghost where it used to hang off orders.

views.title: Service topology
views.caption: The ledger service enters beside the checkout API; the audit service and its synchronous call are removed in place.

views.title: Checkout request sequence
views.caption: POST /checkout gains ledger_ref in the response; the audit call disappears from the critical path.

changes.subject: ledger_entries
changes.detail: append-only, one row per accepted order

changes.subject: orders.ledger_ref
changes.detail: nullable until the ledger write lands
